title: Fix the Modified Constant
description: The program should use a fixed tax rate constant in a calculation.
expectedBehavior: The program should compile and print the tax rate used in the calculation.
actualProblem: taxRate is declared const, meaning it cannot be reassigned after initialization. Attempting taxRate = 0.10 is a compile error: 'assignment of read-only variable taxRate'.
explanation: const marks a variable as read-only after its initial value is set. If a different value is actually needed, it must be assigned once at declaration rather than reassigned later.
